en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing the old National Theatre building and the adjacent square in Bucharest, with a small fountain, trees, and several horse-drawn carriages. Red captions identify the city and subject; publisher information runs vertically along the left margin. The reverse reads "UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE – România – CARTA POSTALA" with address lines only.
